meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 朝說話者、聽話者或指定地點移動；來到、到達

primaryExample.sentenceEn: Come to my office after lunch.

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 事情發生、出現或接著發生

primaryExample.sentenceEn: Her dream of becoming a doctor came true.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 她當醫生的夢想實現了。

expressions.meaningZhHant: 有某些顏色、尺寸或款式可選

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 有某些顏色、尺寸或款式可供選擇，常用 come in 表達

primaryExample.sentenceEn: This jacket comes in three colors.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 這件外套有三種顏色可選。

expressions.meaningZhHant: 排名第一；優先於其他事情

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 排在某個位置或獲得某個名次

primaryExample.sentenceEn: She came first in the race.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 她在比賽中得到第一名。

coreMeaningZhHant: come 的核心是「來」：人可以來到某處，事情也可以「來到眼前」而發生或出現。

examples.sentenceEn: We need to come up with a better plan.
examples.translationZhHant: 我們需要想出更好的計畫。

examples.sentenceEn: Come on! We’re going to be late.
Come on, you can do it!
Oh, come on! You don't really believe that.
examples.translationZhHant: 拜託！你不會真的相信那種事吧。

headwordExpressions.meaningZhHant: 用來催促、鼓勵，或表示不相信、不耐煩

examples.sentenceEn: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
examples.translationZhHant: 我整理房間時，偶然找到一張舊照片。

examples.sentenceEn: Her new book comes out next month.
The phone comes with a charging cable.
examples.translationZhHant: 這支手機附有一條充電線。

mainExample.sentenceEn: Come to my office after lunch.

meaningSummary.meaningZhHant: 來到；發生；變得；來自；有（款式）；排名
